summary: Canadian National Railway Company filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual shareholder meeting held on the same day. The filing details routine items: election of 11 directors all receiving over 94% support, reappointment of KPMG as auditors with 89.69% in favor, and non-binding advisory votes on executive compensation (91.67% for) and the Climate Action Plan (95.99% for). No special-situation event occurred. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure required under Canadian NI 51-102, mapped to the US equivalent of a Form 8-K Item 5.07.
